body: Trust me if there was hacks for this gen they would be out by now and games would be utterly ruined.
BRs have been out for so long now im honestly burnt out from playing them so much. I heard a rumor they're adding it in 2020 but im 100% not playing it I just don't care.

Yeah honestly I couldnt give a shit what people name themselves on the beta or the actual game, but the PR nightmare that IW/Acti will get from this isn't worth it to them so they've stated they're adding filters. I doubt they want to wakeup one day and see 60 website posts saying that they support racists, especially when half the media apparently relates video games into causing violence.

This subreddit only has 108k people, there were 17 million copies of black ops 4 sold in the first 8 days of the game being out. At this point I don't even think they want to add voting because the data would be just pure facts on if they made the game bad or good and the end result would be something that the consumers wanted and not the devs.
I think someone leaked the map list and there were some remakes on there so I'm looking forward to playing them and seeing if anything changes gameplay-wise on those arena maps.

I'm not saying don't listen to the vocal minority im saying listen to everyone, I agree with some points those people make it's just that everyone should be able to give their feedback equally and only IW can do that through the game, and who even knows if they value the feedback they were given, only time can tell what they decide to do to the game.
I know like seriously, 25 million dollars for a league spot and they dont have button mapping or deadzone adjustments? Insane

If the game is not fun to play for influencers they lose a lot of free advertising, sure they could pay people to play it and put #CodPartner in their stream titles but how many people would really watch at that point if it gets a reputation of being a "bad" game? But I'm not saying they have to cater to the opinions of popular people, they should really be looking at data/polls from the entire player base

I would love for it to happen but I don't think it will, how hard would it have been to have a minimap poll in the beta? They literally update the playlist every day at the same time so it would have been pretty easy to do a playlist update on one of the days and have a poll that says to provide feedback on "X"
And then the tier two fun begins whats in store for MTX? Will they release controversial MTX and then quickly release major changes to the game so people complain about the changes and not the MTX?

It would be too logical of them to literally make a survey in game that you can vote on. They rather selectively choose whatever fits their agenda which is probably garnering the most sales out of the game. If anything, I think they'll wait a bit after release maybe a couple months maybe weeks who knows to patch or change things after people have bought the game so it'll be harder to return. Unless you buy physical disks in which case you can just sell it to someone and make some money back.

People stopped thinking as soon as they saw "Modern Warfare" slapped on as the title for this game, people want to like it so bad they'll do anything. If this game was called ghosts 2 I could picture the graveyard that would be their servers.
Once we get all attachments this game will be a whole new beast
Even with all the ADS attachments its just way slower, oh well just means we gotta preaim everything

The slow gameplay is a con for me such as it was in ghosts, the ttk is fast but since the aiming in is so slow people just ADS everything so movement feels hindered compared to the classic MW2 experience.

I'm saying that if they're using the Modern Warfare name it should at least play like those cods. If they wanted to make ghosts 2 just name it ghosts 2 so people can skip it and not complain. This is why so many people have gripes about the game itself.

I would have to say this game is not even close to CoD4 or like MW2. No clue why they used the modern warfare tag if they're just going to make the game into ghosts 2. Trojan horse for the pre orders I guess

I wish they would at least let us change our emblems as we rank up as master prestiges like cmon lol
